policy: Bounded local verification at named revisions. These checks do not promote portfolio states or establish deployment, adoption, or business outcomes.

reviews.title: Compiler-aware refactoring with guarded file changes
reviews.implementation: The TypeScript language service locates rename targets across files. Previews bind the intended edits to source hashes, limit the change scope, and check for new diagnostics before guarded application.
reviews.operations: Refuse a stale preview, lock the write, verify the resulting digest, and recover from partial failures while preserving concurrent edits.
reviews.verification: 24/24 tests passed locally at this revision: 8 compiler-aware refactoring, 10 guarded file-transaction, and 6 semantic symbol-knowledge tests. Node 24.22.1 with isolated TypeScript 5.8.3.
reviews.boundary: Temporary local fixtures verify these components. Portfolio classification remains REFERENCE_ONLY; no all-language CI, crash-safe transaction, production deployment, or customer outcome claim.

reviews.title: Recompile changed inputs without losing prior work
reviews.implementation: Bind generated application packets to source-content digests, reuse unchanged packets, and quarantine superseded artifacts before recompilation.
reviews.operations: Preserve prior lineage, distinguish stale work from current work, and write the input receipt atomically so a later run can make a defensible reuse decision.
reviews.verification: 3/3 freshness-aware batch tests passed locally at this revision: unchanged-input reuse, changed-input quarantine, and legacy-packet preservation.
reviews.boundary: Temporary local fixtures verify packet lifecycle behavior. No external application submission or production throughput is measured.
